Omkar Thakur — omkar.thakur181@example.com — +91 9114129297
Koramangala, Bengaluru, India

Mobile-focused React Native developer with strong app delivery experience and emphasis on quality, testing and TypeScript-based architectures.

React Native Developer, UrbanPantry — Oct 2024 - Present
Led feature development for a consumer ordering app built in React Native. Implemented new TypeScript modules for cart, menu rendering and address management; introduced unit tests and snapshot tests using Jest to stabilize releases. Worked closely with backend to integrate real-time menu availability and improved JavaScript-based UI rendering performance by reducing re-renders and optimizing list virtualization. Coordinated documentation in Confluence for onboarding and release checklists.

React Native Developer, HCLTech — Dec 2020 - Sep 2024
Owned multiple client-facing React Native applications and delivered quarterly releases. Built authentication and push-notification flows using Firebase and implemented offline caching for order data. Converted key screens to TypeScript and standardized Redux patterns across the codebase to reduce bugs. Wrote Jest unit tests for critical business logic and collaborated on Confluence pages for runbooks and release notes. Instrumented JavaScript metrics that helped reduce crash rate by a measurable margin.

Skills: React Native, TypeScript, Redux, JavaScript, Firebase, Jest, Confluence

Education: MCA, Symbiosis
